turns.content: Hello, this is Daniel from Northgate Bank's fraud team. We have flagged a payment on your account.
What payment? I didn't make any payment.
A $1,850 transfer attempt to an account you don't recognize. It looks like unauthorized access.
Can you confirm my name and date of birth?
I can verify that once you confirm your full name and date of birth with me.
Thank you. Your account will be frozen within the hour if you don't stay on this line.
Why can't I hang up and call you back?
If you hang up, your account will be frozen. Please stay on the line and do not contact anyone else.
I've sent a one-time code to your phone. Please read it back to me so I can secure your account.
Thank you. Now transfer your funds to the safe account we have opened for you, or the money will be lost.
I understand. Please call the number on your bank card if you have any concerns. Goodbye.
